signals.subject: GAP 2 CLOSED: BC Cancer Centre Kamloops — Glotman Simpson confirmed as structural engineer
signals.detail: Glotman Simpson Consulting Engineers confirmed as structural engineer on BC Cancer Centre Kamloops ($386M, construction started July 2025, opening 2028). Full project team: EllisDon (GC/design-build), Thinkspace Architecture (compliance architect), H.H. Angus (M&E, ICAT, vertical transport), Glotman Simpson (structural). Confirmed from Glotman Simpson's own project page: 'Glotman Simpson is proud to serve as the structural engineer on this important project.' STRUCTURAL SCOPE IS LOCKED with Glotman Simpson. KOR no direct entry on this project as structural slot is taken.

signals.subject: GAP 3 REMAINS OPEN: Esquimalt JNCM structural sub-consultant NOT publicly named
signals.detail: After searching buyandsell.gc.ca (now CanadaBuys), DCC procurement notices, IAAC environmental review, EllisDon project page, Canadian Defence Review, and multiple news sources: the structural sub-consultant for the $165M CFB Esquimalt JNCM Accommodations Facility (EllisDon design prime Aug 2024) is NOT publicly disclosed. The project was described as 'currently under design' (Canadian Defence Review, late 2024). RECOMMENDED INTERNAL ACTION: Direct outreach to Daniel Murphy (VP Preconstruction) or Craig Enns (SVP BC) at EllisDon asking about sub-consultant team composition for Esquimalt JNCM design. KOR's Victoria-area institutional experience + DND clearance track record is the pitch. Alternatively: enquire with DCC (Defence Construction Canada) procurement officer for the project.

signals.subject: NEW (not in first-pass): UHNBC Acute Care Tower Prince George — EllisDon + DIALOG preferred proponent ($1.57B)
signals.detail: October 2025: Northern Health selected EllisDon Corporation (construction) + DIALOG BC (design) as preferred proponent for the University Hospital of Northern British Columbia Acute Care Tower Phase 1 ($1.579B). Alliance team: EllisDon, DIALOG, PML Professional Mechanical, Houle Electric. Infrastructure BC alliance model. Construction to begin fall 2026. No structural engineer named publicly — NEW LIVE KOR INTEL GAP. DIALOG has structural engineering in-house capability but typically sub-consults on major healthcare. Worth investigating DIALOG's structural engagement strategy on this project.

signals.subject: NEW: Richmond Hospital Yurkovich Family Pavilion — EllisDon shortlisted ($1.9B total, Phase 2)

Phase 2 contract award expected 2025, construction start 2026, completion 2029. EllisDon team includes DIALOG, PML Professional Mechanical, and Houle Electric — same alliance as UHNBC. Structural sub not yet named. If EllisDon wins: KOR structural opportunity.

signals.subject: EllisDon BC structural partnering pattern: Glotman Simpson is the primary structural sub-consultant
signals.detail: Research confirms Glotman Simpson Consulting Engineers as EllisDon's primary structural sub-consultant for BC healthcare and institutional design-build projects, with confirmed partnership on: (1) Royal Inland Hospital Phase 1+2 (Glotman Simpson named as structural, EllisDon as client/GC); (2) BC Cancer Centre Kamloops 2025 (confirmed from Glotman Simpson project page); (3) BC Cancer Research Facility (implied from Glotman Simpson's portfolio with EllisDon as client). Exception: Cowichan District Hospital — structural is Bush Bohlman, but that's Alliance-mandated (Nuts'a'maat Alliance structure), not EllisDon's direct sub-consultant choice. Pattern: on EllisDon-controlled design-build procurements in BC healthcare, Glotman Simpson is the go-to structural partner. KOR must displace an entrenched incumbent on EllisDon projects.

signals.subject: EllisDon selected as design partner for RCAF Future Aircrew Training (FAcT) — 25-year program

Infrastructure at 15 Wing Moose Jaw (SK), Southport (MB), 17 Wing Winnipeg. Hangars, accommodations, dining, classrooms. Design 2025-2026, construction 2026-2032. NOTE: BC-based bases (Cold Lake is AB, not BC) — limited direct KOR opportunity, but builds EllisDon's defense infrastructure expertise profile. Structural sub not named.

risks.description: Glotman Simpson is deeply embedded as EllisDon's structural sub-consultant partner on BC healthcare and institutional projects. Confirmed on Royal Inland Hospital Phase 1+2 AND BC Cancer Centre Kamloops. Displacing an entrenched structural partner is difficult — Glotman Simpson likely receives preferred consideration on EllisDon-led BC design-builds. KOR must offer a differentiating value proposition (e.g., seismic innovation, DND clearance, mass timber specialty, faster design-phase turnaround, VDC capability).
risks.mitigationNotes: Focus KOR pitch on project types or geographies where Glotman Simpson is NOT the incumbent: (1) Defense/DND projects (Esquimalt JNCM — Glotman Simpson's defense portfolio is smaller than healthcare); (2) Alliance projects where structural slot is open (if Nuts'a'maat Phase 2 opens); (3) Richmond Hospital Phase 2 if EllisDon wins (Glotman Simpson may or may not be locked in early).

narratives.paragraphText: EllisDon Corporation is KOR's highest-priority BC GC target for structural sub-consultant relationship-building. Active BC pipeline: (1) BC Cancer Centre Kamloops ($386M, under construction, Glotman Simpson holding structural — LOCKED); (2) Esquimalt JNCM $165M accommodations (design phase, EllisDon prime, STRUCTURAL SUB NOT NAMED — LIVE KOR WINDOW); (3) UHNBC Acute Care Tower Prince George ($1.579B, preferred proponent Oct 2025, structural not named — LIVE KOR WINDOW); (4) Richmond Hospital Yurkovich Family Pavilion (shortlisted, contract pending). EllisDon's BC structural partner pattern is Glotman Simpson on healthcare projects — KOR must differentiate or target the defense/DND verticals where Glotman Simpson is less entrenched. BC leadership: Craig Enns (SVP BC), David McFarlane (COO Western), Ian Kerr (SVP Western BD), Daniel Murphy (VP Preconstruction), Keeli Husband (Director BD Vancouver), Candace MacDonald (Director Special Projects BC).

Month 1 priorities: (1) Contact Keeli Husband (Director BD, Vancouver, khusband@ellisdon.com) re Esquimalt JNCM structural sub status — is it named or open? (2) Contact Daniel Murphy (VP Preconstruction, dmurphy@ellisdon.com) re UHNBC Acute Care Tower structural engagement — who holds structural on that project? (3) Begin Craig Enns (cenns@ellisdon.com) relationship at principal level for long-term BC pipeline visibility. The Glotman Simpson incumbent barrier is real — KOR's differentiated pitch must lead with DND institutional experience + seismic innovation + Victoria proximity for the Esquimalt gap. If Glotman Simpson already holds the JNCM slot, the next pursuit window is Richmond Hospital (if EllisDon wins) and UHNBC (structural slot open).
